title: This is an upgrade (MRE) for WALinuxagent to version 2.15.0.1.
description:
This is an upgrade (MRE) for WALinuxagent to version 2.15.0.1.

package is available at:

https://launchpad.net/~mirespace/+archive/ubuntu/azure
ppa:mirespace/azure


For reference: version 2.11.1.4 was in -proposed and later demoted by Azure squad's manager to jump to waagent instead. Because that work was in ubuntu/jammy-devel, I used it as a starting point, dropping commits that don't apply now due to the new version 2.15.0.1 already contains them. For that reason in the commit history you can see two "New upstream version commits" but only one changelog, on top of the only one published in the archive on updates. 

The review of that pacakage is at https://code.launchpad.net/~mirespace/ubuntu/+source/walinuxagent/+git/walinuxagent/+merge/469956


This is the changelog diff between Resolute and Jammy, picking only the changes that affect Jammy to make the new upstream version workable:
